Commission:

You get 10% commission on every sale. Top Performers Up to 20%.

Payout Policy (Important):

To be eligible for payout, each order must meet the following requirements:

1. The order status must be marked as "Delivered".

2. A 30-day return window must be completed following the delivery date (with the delivery date counting as Day 1, and the window closing at the start of Day 31).

Example: If an order is delivered on May 10, the 30-day return window ends on June 9. As long as the order has not been returned, the commission will be included in the June 15 payout (commissions are processed on the 15th of each month).

3. Minimum payout threshold: Just $15 — withdraw your earnings quickly and easily.


• About our brand and products:

MOKiN is a premium tech accessories brand specializing in:

USB-C Hubs for laptops and tablets

Docking Stations for power users

Portable Power Banks and charging solutions

Loved by creators, students, and professionals across the globe.

• What makes us different:

At MOKiN, we don’t just sell tech accessories — we create high-performance, beautifully designed tools for modern professionals and digital nomads.

Here’s what sets us apart:

🔋 Premium Product Quality – Our USB-C hubs, docking stations, and power banks are built with premium materials, trusted by thousands of customers worldwide.

💻 Cross-Platform Compatibility – Seamless performance with MacBook, Windows laptops, iPads, Steam Deck, and more.

🌍 Global Shipping – We serve customers worldwide with fast, reliable delivery.

💬 Top-rated Customer Support – Real humans, real help — when customers need it most.

📈 High Conversion Rates – Our website is optimized for mobile and desktop buyers, making your referrals more profitable.

• How affiliates can earn:

We offer a flexible and high-converting affiliate program:

🔁 30-day cookie duration – earn commission if your lead purchases within 30 days

💸 Monthly payouts via PayPal or bank transfer

🎟 Custom discount codes for your audience

📊 Real-time analytics via your personal affiliate dashboard

• How to promote us:

Here are some great ways to promote MOKiN products:

📦 Unboxing & Review Videos – Create honest, high-quality content showing how our hubs/docks/power banks work

💬 Social Media Posts – Share product usage on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts

✍️ Blog Reviews & Comparisons – Rank our products alongside competitors (we’re confident you’ll love the results!)

📧 Email Newsletters – Offer exclusive discounts to your subscribers using your custom code

🌐 Deal/Tech Communities – Post our products on Reddit, tech forums, or gadget blogs

We provide everything you need: images, videos, talking points, and your own referral tools.

• Other information:

📦 Free Sample Program – Qualified content creators can receive MOKiN products for free in exchange for quality reviews.

🕐 Fast Support for Affiliates – Need content, help, or data? Our dedicated affiliate team is here for you.

🛠 Product Launches & Campaigns – Be the first to promote our new products with early access and higher commissions

🧾 Clear Terms – No hidden rules. You earn, we pay — simple as that.
